library_manifest.verification_scope: membership rule and selected data bytes only

selection_rule.selection_order: source order bones then lafan40; original clip order within each

paper_profile.name: paper-a5-velocity-local
paper_profile.provenance: local interpretation of paper Tables A.4/A.5
paper_profile.optimizer: Adam for every trainable network parameter; no Muon
paper_profile.schedule: cosine to 0.03 times initial by collection step 250000; then constant
paper_profile.schedule_unit: zero-based simulator collection step, before its learner updates
limitations: Does not supply the missing paper dataset filters or surviving-clip manifest
Does not implement multi-GPU gradient synchronization
Does not implement full training-state resume
Uses the released simulator, normalization and return-sampler implementation
paper_profile.reference_window: Project each reference frame, then centered25-frame mean; clip-edge repetition unconfirmed
paper_profile.reset_weights: Native return sampler scores motion simulator rows only; weights shared for reference resets
paper_profile.velocity_fall_smoothing: Native softness on normalized height/tilt margins; paper specifies only hard thresholds
